pin_diff.note: Pin 4 differs (NC/NC vs BYP/BYPASS): safe only if PCB leaves Pin 4 floating or decoupled via 10 nF to GND; if PCB ties NC pin directly to GND/VIN, trace cut is mandatory.

parameter_matrix.note: Check PCB land pattern & height profile.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (SOT-23-5) vs CAT6219-330TD-GT3 (TSOT-23-5) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.

HIGH PIN 4 (NC vs BYPASS/NR) CHECK: One device uses Pin 4 as an internal bandgap bypass/noise-reduction node while the other is NC. Verify Pin 4 is NOT tied to GND or VIN on the existing PCB before swapping; add a 10 nF bypass cap if low noise is required.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: 1 µF p.2 vs CAT6219-330TD-GT3: 2.2 µF p.3); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 28% higher on CAT6219-330TD-GT3 (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: 184 °C/W p.3 vs CAT6219-330TD-GT3: 235 °C/W p.3); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C) vs CAT6219-330TD-GT3: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2112K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (EOL): CAT6219-330TD-GT3 is flagged EOL by onsemi; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
engineering_verdict: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and CAT6219-330TD-GT3 (onsemi, TSOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because package code differs (SOT-23-5 vs TSOT-23-5; same land pattern, different body profile); Pin 4 NC vs BYPASS difference; minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 46.9 °C on AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 184 °C/W) vs 59.9 °C on CAT6219-330TD-GT3 (θJA 235 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1x ratio (55 µA (p.8) vs 55 µA (p.4)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 "6.5 V Abs Max & SOT25 Thermal Limit at 600 mA From 5 V Input" (p.3) and CAT6219-330TD-GT3 "OBSOLETE / EOL Device — Mandatory Migration Target for Active BOMs" (p.2). BOM decision: Choose AP2112K-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 500 mA (up to 600 mA) or lower package θJA (184 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose CAT6219-330TD-GT3 when matching your existing onsemi TSOT-23-5 (CASE 419AE (TD)) qualification and -40..125 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.2) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
